meta.name: qt-signals-slots-convention
meta.description: Standardize signal and slot naming and responsibility boundaries in Qt components. Use when event flow is inconsistent.

copy.tagline: 统一Qt组件中信号与槽的命名和职责边界
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果Qt项目里信号与槽的命名和事件流不一致
copy.tagline_en: Standardize signal and slot naming and responsibility boundaries in Qt components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Qt project has inconsistent signal/slot naming and event flow

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 Qt 信号与槽的命名规范（如 somethingChanged、requestX、errorOccurred）来设计组件通信，并明确视图与控制器的职责边界。
howto.when: 当你在 Qt 项目中遇到事件流不一致或需要标准化信号/槽命名时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个 Qt 组件的信号命名是否符合规范。
say.note: Claude 会依据命名规则审查并给出修改建议。

say.text: 为这个按钮点击事件设计信号和槽的职责边界。
say.note: Claude 会输出视图发射意图、控制器执行工作的契约。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will enforce Qt signal and slot naming conventions (e.g., somethingChanged, requestX, errorOccurred) and define clear responsibility boundaries between view and controller.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to standardize signal/slot naming or fix inconsistent event flow in a Qt project.

say_en.text: Check the signal naming of this Qt component for convention compliance.
say_en.note: Claude will review and suggest fixes based on naming rules.

say_en.text: Design the signal-slot responsibility boundary for this button click event.
